channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about D'Angelo Russell | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about D'Angelo Russell from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jason Kidd on D'Angelo Russell
item.description:
Kidd on Russell:

“I think looking at the scoring and being able to playmake gave us another guy out there who can dribble and break pressure.”

Jason Kidd on D'Angelo Russell, Oct 27, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on D'Angelo Russell
item.description:
Fernandez said of Russell's limited playing time.

“But [D'Angelo] has been dealing with the ankle. And just trying to be smart with that, too. He’s been pretty sore, and I just don’t want to run it through the ground.”

Jordi Fernandez on D'Angelo Russell, Apr 4, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on D'Angelo Russell, Ben Simmons
item.description:
Jordi Fernandez:

“D'Angelo [Russell] had a shin contusion, so we'll keep him out for today, and then we'll see how he feels. With Ben [Simmons], it's just management with his calf... Want him to feel better and [we'll] see how many days it takes. We're not going to rush him.”

Jordi Fernandez on D'Angelo Russell, Ben Simmons, Jan 6, 2025. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Sean Marks on D'Angelo Russell
item.description:
Sean Marks on reacquiring D'Angelo Russell:

“I know he's excited to be back here. There's something to be said for the continuity of knowing what you're getting into. He's familiar... We'll welcome him back with open arms. He's a heck of a talent.”

Sean Marks on D'Angelo Russell, Jan 2, 2025. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Linas Kleiza on D'Angelo Russell
item.description:
Kleiza, who played four seasons with the Denver Nuggets and three with the Toronto Raptors, shared that one of the goals of his visit will be to discuss the possibility of Russell representing Lithuania.

“We are honored that D'Angelo Russell has expressed interest in playing for Lithuania,”

Linas Kleiza on D'Angelo Russell, Nov 28, 2024. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: JJ Redick on D'Angelo Russell
item.description:
JJ Redick on D’Angelo Russell:

“I would say he’s one of the more vocal leaders on our team.”

JJ Redick on D'Angelo Russell, Nov 1, 2024. Source: Twitter @khobi_price.

item.title: LeBron James on Kobe Bryant, D'Angelo Russell
item.description:
“D’Angelo is a playmaker that’s used to having the ball in his hands but you have to understand that’s not your role anymore. I’m talking about D’Angelo Russell now. You have to become a spot up shooter when you’re playing with a guy like LeBron James; almost like I had to play when I was playing with Kobe Bryant. But again, you have to know how to adapt to your teammates and that’s what good basketball players do, you know? You know what your role is on certain teams and then elevate your game to that level that it needs to be.”

LeBron James on Kobe Bryant, D'Angelo Russell, Oct 8, 2024. Source: ScoopB.com.

item.title: Darvin Ham on D'Angelo Russell
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Darvin Ham on D'Angelo Russell's performance (0-7, zero points):

“It's unfortunate, man. He had some good looks that he just didn't knock down. It's as simple as that. Similar to Game 1. He was able to bounce back in Game 2, and I expect him to bounce back in Game 4.”

Darvin Ham on D'Angelo Russell, Apr 26, 2024. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Dennis Schroder on D'Angelo Russell
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Dennis Schroder on D'Angelo Russell's comments:

“I don't understand it. But at the end of the day, it just shows off immaturity. You're not really mature if you’re just keeping somebody's name in his mouth and just running it. I don't understand.”

Dennis Schroder on D'Angelo Russell, Mar 15, 2024. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Darvin Ham on D'Angelo Russell, Austin Reaves
item.description:
Lakers coach Darvin Ham on the dynamic between D'Angelo Russell & Austin Reaves:

“Their synergy has been great. They support one another wholeheartedly, and it's a joy to coach them both.”

Darvin Ham on D'Angelo Russell, Austin Reaves, Jan 19, 2024. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Anthony Davis on D'Angelo Russell
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Anthony Davis on D'Angelo Russell:

“He comes in and puts the work in. He stays engaged, and when he gets on the floor, he produces. He's an elite scorer and an elite playmaker, and like I said, when he's playing at that level, we were a tough team to beat.”

Anthony Davis on D'Angelo Russell, Jan 18, 2024. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Derrick White on D'Angelo Russell
item.description:
“Whether it shows up on the stat sheet or not, just doing the things that your team needs to do. And that’s just what I’m trying to do is whatever I can do to help this team win, whether that means scoring 20 points or getting two shots. Whatever it is to help us win, I’m willing to do that. So I think that’s what (Russell) was trying to say.”

Derrick White on D'Angelo Russell, Oct 17, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Darvin Ham on D'Angelo Russell
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Ham on D'Angelo Russell:

“He's been great with his communication all summer. Seeing him in workouts and pickup games; he's vocal, he's encouraging the new guys; he had a couple workouts just with LeBron and AD.”

Darvin Ham on D'Angelo Russell, Sep 28, 2023. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Gilbert Arenas on D'Angelo Russell
item.description:
“How many shots did (D’Angelo Russell) take after last game? Probably like 200. Then come the next game to take two shots?! Man, get the fu*k off of my team. The fu*k you doin’ on my team for? If I’m watching you, and you’re taking two, three hundred shots, and you come in the NBA game, the last game, and you take four fu*king shots? Alright, good job. Fu*k off my team.”

Gilbert Arenas on D'Angelo Russell, May 23, 2023. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Michael Malone on D'Angelo Russell
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Michael Malone:

“In Game 1, a guy that’s played really well for them was not on the floor in the 4th quarter in D’Angelo Russell. That to me is an interesting storyline. Are they going to play him, are they not going to play him?”

Michael Malone on D'Angelo Russell, May 17, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Austin Reaves on D'Angelo Russell
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Austin Reaves on D'Angelo Russell:

“He's a really good basketball player that plays the game the right way. You don't really see him too many times in the midst of a game making a wild play. He's very under control, plays at his own pace, & like I said, he's just super talented.”

Austin Reaves on D'Angelo Russell, Mar 11, 2023. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Darvin Ham on D'Angelo Russell
item.description:
Darvin Ham on D’Angelo Russell:

“He went through a full practice today and we expect him to be available for tomorrow.”

Darvin Ham on D'Angelo Russell, Mar 9, 2023. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: LeBron James on D'Angelo Russell, Jarred Vanderbilt, Malik Beasley
item.description:
LeBron on the Lakers since the trade deadline (they’re 4-1 since acquiring Russell, Vanderbilt and Beasley):

“I feel like we’re in a good place. We’re gonna try to continue that.”

LeBron James on D'Angelo Russell, Jarred Vanderbilt, Malik Beasley, Feb 26, 2023. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on D'Angelo Russell, Jarred Vanderbilt
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Rob Pelinka:

“We are thrilled to add D’Angelo, Malik and Jarred to our organization and are confident their talents will boost our ability to finish the season strongly. In this trade, we’ve added switchable wing defending, perimeter shooting and rebounding depth.”

Rob Pelinka on D'Angelo Russell, Jarred Vanderbilt, Feb 9, 2023. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Rudy Gobert on D'Angelo Russell
item.description:
Rudy Gobert on playing with D'Angelo Russell during today's Timberwolves practice:

“He can see it all. There’s a few times when I didn’t know that he saw me, and he still saw me. It’s really impressive and it’s really exciting.”

Rudy Gobert on D'Angelo Russell, Sep 27, 2022. Source: Twitter @ChristopherHine.

item.title: Paul Pierce on Rudy Gobert, D'Angelo Russell, Anthony Edwards
item.description:
“I think it’s gonna short them up in the playoffs. They ain’t gonna be a seven eight seed, I think they can be a top-four seed now. Thatkid Edwards gonna be better, D’Angelo Russell has to stay, he can knock down shots. He’s just gotta figure it out, I don’t need him to be no All-Star, He’s just gotta knock down shots and be solid. Rudy Gobert going to sure up the Timberwolves’ defense now. They couldn’t defend. They had a hard time just defending Memphis. They kept getting walked down,”

Paul Pierce on Rudy Gobert, D'Angelo Russell, Anthony Edwards, Sep 21, 2022. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Glen Taylor on D'Angelo Russell
item.description:
Asked if he’d like to see D’Angelo Russell sign an extension before the season begins, Taylor said it might benefit both sides to hold off and see how the 2022/23 season goes.

“(Finch) believes that with the new lineup, and with Russell in that lineup, that he’ll have a much better year just because of the way we’re going to play,”

Glen Taylor on D'Angelo Russell, Aug 11, 2022. Source: Hoops Rumors.

item.title: Glen Taylor on D'Angelo Russell
item.description:
“He says he thinks there’s a big upside for Russell with this group of (players). That’s to his advantage and to our advantage if it works out.”

Glen Taylor on D'Angelo Russell, Aug 11, 2022. Source: Hoops Rumors.

item.title: Patrick Beverley on D'Angelo Russell
item.description:
Beverley on D'Angelo Russell:

“I feel like he could have ended better. Everyone felt that, he felt that. We need him a lot and, just one of those series. And it's something he's gonna learn from.”

Patrick Beverley on D'Angelo Russell, Apr 30, 2022. Source: Twitter @ChristopherHine.

item.title: Jacqueline Towns on D'Angelo Russell
item.description:
His boys were singing his praises after Saturday.

“That's probably one of the best D'Angelo Russell performances I've ever seen,”

Jacqueline Towns on D'Angelo Russell, Nov 28, 2021. Source: Minneapolis Star-Tribune.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on D'Angelo Russell
item.description:
Anthony Edwards on him, KAT and Russell:

“We think we the only ones on the team. We got to be willing to pass the ball. There’s no “I”

Anthony Edwards on D'Angelo Russell, Oct 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @JonKrawczynski.

item.title: Ryan Saunders on D'Angelo Russell
item.description:
Dane Moore:Ryan Saunders on D'Angelo Russell's injury:

“It’s a big loss for us. It’s something that there was a lot of diligence. Everybody was proactive and gathering opinions and seeing what the best course of action for D’Angelo was in the short term and long term. And this was it.”

Ryan Saunders on D'Angelo Russell, Feb 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on D'Angelo Russell, Malik Beasley
item.description:
Anthony Edwards on the D'Angelo Russell, Malik Beasley and Edwards three-man backcourt:

“They can't help off of DLo and Bease because they can shoot. And they can't help off of me because I can shoot -- *starts laughing* -- every now and again.”

Anthony Edwards on D'Angelo Russell, Malik Beasley, Feb 1, 2021. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on D'Angelo Russell
item.description:
For these two Timberwolves who have developed a kinship, it has been important for them to use their NBA platforms even when it’s been most uncomfortable this year.

“Me and [Russell] have had conversations about understanding that, and understanding the power of this moment and this opportunity,”

Karl-Anthony Towns on D'Angelo Russell, Dec 9, 2020. Source: The Undefeated.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on D'Angelo Russell, Karl-Anthony Towns
item.description:
Anthony Edwards on playing with Karl-Anthony Towns and D'Angelo Russell in Minnesota:

“I've got two superstars alongside of me, so I'm not really going to feel too much pressure.”

Anthony Edwards on D'Angelo Russell, Karl-Anthony Towns, Nov 18, 2020. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.
